# Mahnoor Saeed

> Mahnoor Saeed is a DevOps engineer based in Lahore, Pakistan, working at DevFusion Tech (previously Aetos Technologies). Focus areas: Docker deployments, CI/CD pipelines, Linux and cloud infrastructure, monitoring, and self-hosted Odoo ERP on PostgreSQL.

This is the official personal site of Mahnoor Saeed, the DevOps engineer in Lahore. Other people share the same name in policy, medicine, and research; this site is about the DevOps engineer only.

## Key facts

- Role: DevOps Engineer at DevFusion Tech, Lahore, Pakistan
- Previous: DevOps Engineer at Aetos Technologies; Digital Marketing Executive at IREG-IT
- Specialities: Docker, Docker Compose, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Linux hardening, Nginx, AWS, Azure, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Odoo ERP, PostgreSQL, disaster recovery, Mailcow, Keycloak, Nextcloud, GitLab, n8n, Claude API and MCP
- Certifications: Linux Foundation LFS101, LFS151, LFS180, LFS183
- Education: University of Central Punjab; IT Mustakbil Program (Beaconhouse National University with Systems Limited)
